conversation.Statement: Thank you for contacting the IRS Economic Relief Center. My name is Mr. Daniels, certified tax consultant. How may I assist you with your taxes today?
Hi, um, I got a text about a tax refund I might qualify for. I do rideshare and delivery, so I wasn't sure if it was real.

That's an excellent question. The IRS is issuing special stimulus refunds this season for gig workers like yourself who reported self-employment income. Let me check your eligibility. Can I have your full name and the last four digits of your Social Security Number?
Sure, it's Jamie Carter, and my SSN ends in 8342.
Thank you, Ms. Carter. According to our records, you qualify for a $2,700 stimulus refund under the Gig Economy Support Act. This is a significant amount, congratulations!
Oh wow, that's a lot. I wasn't expecting anything like that.

Yes, it's a special IRS initiative to support workers like you. However, to process your refund, there is a small mandatory federal clearance fee of $98 for identity verification and fraud prevention. This ensures your refund is released directly to your account and not intercepted.
Wait, I have to pay something to get my refund? That doesn't sound right.

I understand your concern. But due to increased tax fraud involving gig workers, the IRS now requires this step. If the clearance isn't completed today, your refund will be placed on hold and potentially forfeit until next tax season.
Oh, I really need that money now. How do I pay the fee?
For your convenience, we accept the clearance fee via Zelle or prepaid gift cards such as Apple or Target. Which method works best for you?
Um, I guess I could do a gift card. I don't have Zelle set up.

Perfect. Please go to a nearby store and purchase an Apple or Target gift card for $98. Once you have it, read me the code on the back so I can verify your payment and process your refund immediately.
Okay, I can do that. But how fast will I get my refund after?
Once the clearance payment is received, you will see the $2,700 deposited to the bank account associated with your last tax filing, usually within 30 to 60 minutes.
Alright, I'm heading to the store now.
Thank you, Ms. Carter. Please stay on the line or call me back immediately once you have the gift card. Remember, this is a time-sensitive IRS process. Delays could cancel your refund.
Okay, I understand. I'll be quick.
That's good. Just to reiterate, if the clearance payment isn't processed today, your eligibility will expire, and the IRS may initiate a review that could lead to penalties for unverified income.
Oh, I definitely don't want that. I'll get the card now.
Excellent. Once you have the card, please scratch the panel on the back and read me the full code. Do not share this code with anyone else, as it is used exclusively for IRS verification.
